column1: A critical ingredient in the success of hotels is developing and maintaining superior performance from their employees.
column2: 要让酒店经营成功，关键之一是帮助员工取得并保持出色的工作表现。

column1: How is that accomplished?
column2: 那么，该如何做到这一点？

column1: What Human Resource Management (HRM) practices should organizations invest in to acquire and retain great employees?
column2: 为了招到并留住优秀员工，组织应该在哪些人力资源管理（HRM）措施上投入资金？
column3: Human Resource Management|人力资源管理

column1: Some hotels aim to provide superior working conditions for their employees.
column2: 有些酒店致力于为员工提供优越的工作条件。
column5: superior working conditions|优越的工作条件

column1: The idea originated from workplaces — usually in the non-service sector — that emphasized fun and enjoyment as part of work-life balance.
column2: 这种观念源自某些工作场所，往往是在服务业以外的行业。这些地方强调，工作与生活的平衡也包括工作中的乐趣。
column8: work-life balance|工作与生活的平衡

column1: By contrast, the service sector, and more specifically hotels, has traditionally not extended these practices to address basic employee needs, such as good working conditions.
column2: 相比之下，服务业，尤其是酒店业，历来没有把这类做法推广到满足员工的基本需要上，例如提供良好的工作条件。
column8: address basic employee needs|满足员工的基本需要

column1: Pfeffer (1994) emphasizes that in order to succeed in a global business environment, organizations must make investment in Human Resource Management (HRM) to allow them to acquire employees who possess better skills and capabilities than their competitors.
column2: Pfeffer（1994）强调，要在全球商业环境中取得成功，组织必须在人力资源管理上投资，这样才有可能招到技能和能力优于竞争对手员工的人才。
column4: global business environment|全球商业环境

column1: This investment will be to their competitive advantage.
column2: 这项投资会为它们带来竞争优势。

column1: Despite this recognition of the importance of employee development, the hospitality industry has historically been dominated by underdeveloped HR practices (Lucas, 2002).
column2: 尽管员工发展的重要性已得到承认，长期以来，酒店服务业占主导地位的仍是并不成熟的人力资源管理做法（Lucas，2002）。
column9: HR practices|人力资源管理做法

column1: Lucas also points out that ‘the substance of HRM practices does not appear to be designed to foster constructive relations with employees or to represent a managerial approach that enables developing and drawing out the full potential of people, even though employees may be broadly satisfied with many aspects of their work’ (Lucas, 2002).
column2: Lucas还指出：“从实质上看，人力资源管理措施似乎既没有着眼于与员工建立有建设性的关系，也没有体现出一种能够培养并充分发掘员工潜力的管理方式，尽管员工可能对工作的许多方面大体满意。”（Lucas，2002）
column4: HRM practices|人力资源管理措施

column1: In addition, or maybe as a result, high employee turnover has been a recurring problem throughout the hospitality industry.
column2: 此外，或许也正因如此，高离职率一直是整个酒店服务业反复出现的问题。

column1: Among the many cited reasons are low compensation, inadequate benefits, poor working conditions and compromised employee morale and attitudes (Maroudas et al., 2008).
column2: 人们提出的众多原因包括薪酬低、福利不足、工作条件差、员工士气受挫和工作态度消极（Maroudas等，2008）。
column6: poor working conditions|恶劣的工作条件

column1: Ng and Sorensen (2008) demonstrated that when managers provide recognition to employees, motivate employees to work together, and remove obstacles preventing effective performance, employees feel more obligated to stay with the company.
column2: Ng和Sorensen（2008）发现，管理者若肯定员工、鼓励员工合作，并清除妨碍他们有效工作的障碍，员工就会觉得自己更有义务留在公司。

column1: This was succinctly summarized by Michel et al. (2013): ‘[P]roviding support to employees gives them the confidence to perform their jobs better and the motivation to stay with the organization.’
column2: Michel等（2013）对此作了简要概括：“支持员工，能让他们有信心把工作做得更好，也有动力留在组织里。”
column7: perform their jobs better|把工作做得更好

column1: Hospitality organizations can therefore enhance employee motivation and retention through the development and improvement of their working conditions.
column2: 因此，酒店服务企业可以通过建设和改善员工的工作条件，提高员工的积极性并留住他们。

column1: These conditions are inherently linked to the working environment.
column2: 这些条件与工作环境本就密切相关。

column1: While it seems likely that employees’ reactions to their job characteristics could be affected by a predisposition to view their work environment negatively, no evidence exists to support this hypothesis (Spector et al., 2000).
column2: 有些员工原本就倾向于负面看待工作环境，这种倾向似乎可能影响他们对自身工作特点的反应。然而，目前没有证据支持这一假设（Spector等，2000）。

column1: However, given the opportunity, many people will find something to complain about in relation to their workplace (Poulston, 2009).
column2: 不过，只要有机会，许多人总能从自己的工作场所找出点可抱怨的事（Poulston，2009）。

column1: There is a strong link between the perceptions of employees and particular factors of their work environment that are separate from the work itself, including company policies, salary and vacations.
column2: 员工的看法与工作环境中的某些因素密切相关。这些因素独立于工作内容本身，包括公司政策、薪水和休假。

column1: Such conditions are particularly troubling for the luxury hotel market, where high-quality service, requiring a sophisticated approach to HRM, is recognized as a critical source of competitive advantage (Maroudas et al., 2008).
column2: 这些状况在豪华酒店市场尤其令人担忧。在这一市场，优质服务被公认为竞争优势的重要来源，而提供优质服务需要成熟的人力资源管理方式（Maroudas等，2008）。
column4: luxury hotel market|豪华酒店市场
column6: sophisticated approach|成熟而精细的方式

column1: In a real sense, the services of hotel employees represent their industry (Schneider and Bowen, 1993).
column2: 就实际意义而言，酒店员工提供的服务代表着他们所从事的行业（Schneider和Bowen，1993）。
column3: In a real sense|就实际意义而言

column1: This representation has commonly been limited to guest experiences.
column2: 人们通常只从宾客体验的角度来理解员工服务的这种代表作用。

column1: This suggests that there has been a dichotomy between the guest environment provided in luxury hotels and the working conditions of their employees.
column2: 这表明，豪华酒店为宾客营造的环境与员工自身的工作条件之间存在明显的落差。
column4: dichotomy|n. 两者之间的分化对立

column1: It is therefore essential for hotel management to develop HRM practices that enable them to inspire and retain competent employees.
column2: 因此，酒店管理层有必要建立能够激励并留住称职员工的人力资源管理机制。
column5: HRM practices|人力资源管理措施

column1: This requires an understanding of what motivates employees at different levels of management and different stages of their careers (Enz and Siguaw, 2000).
column2: 这就需要了解，哪些因素能激励处于不同管理层级、不同职业阶段的员工（Enz和Siguaw，2000）。
column7: stages of their careers|职业生涯的不同阶段

column1: This implies that it is beneficial for hotel managers to understand what practices are most favorable to increase employee satisfaction and retention.
column2: 也就是说，酒店经理若能了解哪些做法最有利于提高员工满意度和留任率，会对管理工作有所帮助。

column1: Herzberg (1966) proposes that people have two major types of needs, the first being extrinsic motivation factors relating to the context in which work is performed, rather than the work itself.
column2: Herzberg（1966）提出，人有两大类需要。第一类涉及外在激励因素，即工作在怎样的环境中进行，而与工作内容本身无关。
column4: two major types of needs|两大类需要
column5: extrinsic motivation factors|外在激励因素

column1: These include working conditions and job security.
column2: 这类因素包括工作条件和工作的稳定性。

column1: When these factors are unfavorable, job dissatisfaction may result.
column2: 当这些条件不理想时，员工就可能对工作产生不满。

column1: Significantly, though, just fulfilling these needs does not result in satisfaction, but only in the reduction of dissatisfaction (Maroudas et al., 2008).
column2: 不过，有很重要的一点：仅仅满足这些需要，得到的只是较少的不满，并不会带来满意（Maroudas等，2008）。
column7: reduction of dissatisfaction|不满情绪的减轻

column1: Employees also have intrinsic motivation needs or motivators, which include such factors as achievement and recognition.
column2: 员工还需要内在激励，也就是激励因素，包括取得成就和得到认可。

column1: Unlike extrinsic factors, motivator factors may ideally result in job satisfaction (Maroudas et al., 2008).
column2: 与外部因素不同，激励因素在理想情况下可能带来工作满意感（Maroudas等，2008）。

column1: Herzberg’s (1966) theory discusses the need for a ‘balance’ of these two types of needs.
column2: Herzberg（1966）的理论还讨论了在这两类需要之间保持“平衡”的必要性。

column1: The impact of fun as a motivating factor at work has also been explored.
column2: 研究者还探讨了工作中的乐趣作为一种激励因素能产生怎样的影响。

column1: For example, Tews, Michel and Stafford (2013) conducted a study focusing on staff from a chain of themed restaurants in the United States.
column2: 例如，Tews、Michel和Stafford（2013）开展了一项研究，对象是美国一家连锁主题餐厅的员工。
column3: conducted a study|开展一项研究
column6: a chain of|一系列连锁经营的

column1: It was found that fun activities had a favorable impact on performance and manager support for fun had a favorable impact in reducing turnover.
column2: 研究发现，趣味活动对工作表现有积极影响，而管理者对这类活动的支持则有助于降低离职率。

column1: Their findings support the view that fun may indeed have a beneficial effect, but the framing of that fun must be carefully aligned with both organizational goals and employee characteristics.
column2: 研究结果支持这样一种看法：乐趣的确可能带来好处，但如何安排这些活动，必须既符合组织目标，也契合员工特点。

column1: ‘Managers must learn how to achieve the delicate balance of allowing employees the freedom to enjoy themselves at work while simultaneously maintaining high levels of performance’ (Tews et al., 2013).
column2: “管理者必须学会把握微妙的平衡：既给员工在工作中享受乐趣的自由，又同时保持高水平的工作表现。”（Tews等，2013）
column3: achieve the delicate balance|取得微妙的平衡
column8: levels of performance|工作表现水平

column1: Deery (2008) has recommended several actions that can be adopted at the organizational level to retain good staff as well as assist in balancing work and family life.
column2: Deery（2008）建议，组织可以采取多项措施来留住优秀员工，同时帮助员工在工作与家庭生活之间取得平衡。
column6: retain good staff|留住优秀员工

column1: Those particularly appropriate to the hospitality industry include allowing adequate breaks during the working day, staff functions that involve families, and providing health and well-being opportunities.
column2: 其中尤其适合酒店服务业的措施包括，给员工充足的工间休息，举办可让家属参加的员工活动，并提供促进身心健康的机会。
